title: UX-01 task 3: the room frame
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 3: NavigationBar (wordmark, the primary destinations of blueprint §10.1 as links with aria-current and a weight-plus-underline current marker, a menu holding them below the wide layout, status and account slots; decision D28's top bar) and AccountMenu (neutral initials avatar and name opening Profile, Settings and the fan-content notice). RoomFrame (skip link, navigation slot, main landmark at the standard content width, perimeter gutters reserved for ink-form artwork at expanded widths), RoomHeader (level-1 room title, context line, demonstration notice, actions), DemonstrationLabel (the fixed demonstration sentence) and InkFormSlot (decorative reservation outlined with its name and extent only when the root data-artwork-slots attribute is set). All Experimental, with documentation contracts and stories for every documented state.

Component tokens avatar.size ({space.8}), avatar.radius ({radius.pill}) and room.ink-gutter ({space.16}), with regenerated token outputs; the menu icon (Phosphor List) added to the curated registry with its meaning; seven component strings. The navigation bar's content edge follows the room gutters and perimeter reservation so the wordmark aligns with the room content.

Storybook preview: an 'Artwork slots' toolbar global that sets the root attribute, and parameters.designSystem.bleed for room stories. stories/support/reference/: room text through useReferenceText (en-XA lengthens it), storyHref links between reference stories that keep the toolbar globals, and ReferenceNavigation/ReferenceRoom with invented demonstration player names, a working notifications list and the fan-content notice dialog. stories/reference/RoomFrame.stories.tsx: frame, artwork slots shown, secondary surface, long labels, title only and the honest page for rooms outside the reference set.

tests/browser/reference.spec.ts adds seven room-frame tests: skip link first and focusing main, the current destination marked beyond colour, the collapsed menu at 820 px with focus restored, ink-form slots unfocusable, aria-hidden and clear of every control, the account menu and fan-content notice, the quiet count opening its list on demand, and a non-reference destination leading to an honest page. RUN-20261022-015 passes the gates and 193/193 Chromium tests, including axe in both themes and 44 px targets for the new stories.

Visual review of captures (Paper 1440 x 900, Ink 820 x 1180, Paper 1920 x 1080 with slots shown) found the wordmark misaligned with the room content and a gutter mismatch at 820 px; both were fixed before the receipts above and the recapture confirmed alignment. Captures are in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/.
Design-system runbook gains a reference-screens section; the design-system validation's UX-01 build section records task 3.
